strategy_roster.name: Force DiverSign
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,3) and roc(ema(volume * roc(close,1),5),1) > 0 and roc(ema(volume * roc(close,1),13),1) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: high >= donchian_high_prev(high,3) and roc(ema(volume * roc(close,1),5),1) < 0 and roc(ema(volume * roc(close,1),13),1) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: The Force Index is built as volume times the 1-bar return and smoothed with EMA(5) fast and EMA(13) slow (Period1/Period2 have no documented values), then the buy is a 3-bar low with both Force series turning up and the sell the mirrored case. The down-up-down candle pattern and the fast/slow opposite-direction test between first and third candle need shifted reads not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: JSatl Digit System
strategy_roster.notes: Jurik MA is approximated by EMA(14) using the documented JmaLength, with the rising slope and close-above-average confirmation for the long and both reversed for the exit. The 4-hour candle type and Jurik phase parameter have no DSL equivalent and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: EMA Sticker
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MA period of 5 with a close crossing the EMA is a direct translation, and the opposite cross is the documented exit. The optional 0.001 stop and 0.001 target are absolute price units, so SL/TP stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Basic MA Template
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Simple MA of period 49 gives the open-below/close-above long rule with the mirrored exit standing in for the protection module. The previous-candle evaluation, the iMA-style forward shift and the 38.5/48.5-pip stop and target are not expressible, so SL/TP stay null.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP Pro V21
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,9) and ema(close,9) > ema(close,21) and close > ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP cannot be computed in the DSL, so the long side uses the documented EMA(9)/EMA(21) alignment plus the higher-timeframe EMA(50) trend filter on the traded series, exiting when either fails. The 0.7x/1.4x ATR(14) take-profit and stop are volatility distances, not fixed percentages, so the SL/TP fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: HTF Candles Lib
strategy_roster.notes: A utility library that rebuilds higher-timeframe candles from 1-minute data and logs their structure, documented with no entry, no exit and no stops. The never-true guard records that no market signal exists to translate.

strategy_roster.name: Random Entry and Exit
strategy_roster.notes: Entries and exits are driven by random numbers below the configured thresholds, so no deterministic market-derived condition exists and the same DSL would give unreproducible results. The never-true guard is used instead of a fabricated signal.

strategy_roster.name: PS January Barometer Backtester
strategy_roster.notes: The rule is calendar-anchored seasonality: a February-June close above the January high, a December exit and optional Santa Claus Rally / First Five Days filters on monthly candles. The DSL has no month or date field, so the never-true guard is used rather than substituting an arbitrary rolling window.

strategy_roster.name: Mechanical Trading
strategy_roster.notes: Entry is purely a clock condition (one market order at Trade Hour 16 with the direction set by Short Mode), so there is no market-derived long signal; the never-true guard is used. The documented percent protection is preserved as 0.2% stop and 0.4% target.

strategy_roster.name: Larry Conners SMTP
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low(low,10) and (high - low) > sma(high - low,10) and close > low + 0.75 * (high - low)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 10-bar lowest low, largest-range bar and top-25% range close combine directly, with the largest-range test approximated by range versus its 10-bar average and the highest-low trailing exit by a 5-bar low. The buy stop one tick above the high cannot be placed in this engine, so the signal is taken at the next open.
